raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

This PR updates the `Dockerfile.rock_base` to use `torch 2.13` as well as the `torchvision `version to `0.28.0` so that it matches what is currently in `Dockerfile.rocm_base`. The `build/rock.txt` pins are also updated for consistency, even though they don't appear to be used right now.

## Claims

This should build.

## Validation

Builds locally.

## Details

This is to support the coming switch to `The Rock 10`: https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58761.  This https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/50605 updated torch and `torchvision` but the the `Dockerfile.rock_base` also needs to be updated.

---

</details>
